Dilatation of the cervix (7 cm or more)
outcome: Fetal heart rate (FHR) abnormalities after combined spinal-epidural analgesia (CSEA)
cohort: The study included 393 women with singleton term deliveries who received combined spinal-epidural analgesia at the study institution.
finding: Rupture of the membrane and an advanced dilated cervix were significantly associated with an increased risk of fetal heart rate abnormalities after combined spinal-epidural analgesia.
mod_finding: Fetal heart rate abnormalities were not significantly associated with cesarean delivery during labor or instrumental delivery.
cross-section timing: Medical records from January 1 to December 31, 2017, were analyzed.
